request.raw_text: Remove the collision between handle and cofeepot.
functional_intention_words: Remove the collision between handle and cofeepot

aim.primary_aim: Ensure that the handle and coffeepot do not collide while preserving the remainder of the model.

functional_design_intentions.name: Collision avoidance
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide a collision-free relationship between the handle and the referenced coffeepot geometry.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: The interfering geometry between the handle and cofeepot

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all geometry not required to change for removal of the handle-to-cofeepot collision.

geometry.description: The handle and coffeepot geometry are free of the identified collision.

functions.name: Collision-free handle integration
functions.description: The handle is integrated with the coffeepot without the identified collision.

behaviors.name: Avoid geometric interference
behaviors.description: The handle and coffeepot do not geometrically interpenetrate in the relevant model state.

validation_criteria.description: No geometric collision exists between the handle and coffeepot in the relevant model state.
The final handle-to-coffeepot arrangement is collision-free.
The handle and coffeepot do not interpenetrate in the relevant model state.
Geometry unrelated to resolving the handle-to-coffeepot collision remains unchanged.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not identify whether the handle, the coffeepot, or both may be changed to remove the collision.
It is unclear whether collision refers to static geometric overlap or collision during an intended range of motion.
candidate_interpretations: Remove static geometric interference in the current model state
Provide clearance throughout an intended motion range

unresolved_requirements.description: The referenced term "cofeepot" is presumed to mean "coffeepot," but no exact model identifier is supplied.
candidate_interpretations: The coffeepot body or assembly referenced by the engineer
